findings.detail: OA-M02 combined stopped-A choice not locally cached, only native cached. Optional independent callback runs per invocation.
OA-M03 at most one candidate-local parent-stop owner; OA40 may supplement direct; OA70 final exact-cause arbitration separate.
OL-M02 direct creation can retain null crossing. Legacy eager post-stop confirmation bound is not a current-row strict confirmation recheck; native stream explicit strict gate.
W1 intersections traceability only, no arbitrary callback/sortedness/runtime proof; F05 and CP333-R01/R02 open.
